notes: The colophon names no persons. Vālmīki appears only as part of the text title and is not a person in the production of this copy. The era is not stated. The catalogue gives Samvat 1847. A four-digit year in a Devanagari manuscript most likely means VS, which gives about 1790 CE. Under NS the year would be about 2727 CE, which is impossible. ŚS 1847 would be about 1925 CE, which is possible but less likely.
